title: digitalis purpurea subsp. dubia
intro: Digitalis purpurea subsp. dubia, commonly known as purple foxglove, is a subspecies of the flowering plant Digitalis purpurea, which is native to Europe. The plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including the treatment of heart conditions, such as atrial fibrillation and congestive heart failure. The therapeutic actions of Digitalis purpurea subsp. dubia include increasing the force of heart contractions and slowing the heart rate, which can help improve the heart's efficiency. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, such as digoxin and digitoxin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
